mapper.select: select bok.BOOKSET_ID BOOKSET_ID, bok.BOOKSET_NAME BOOKSET_NAME, bok.BOOKSET_FULLNAME BOOKSET_FULLNAME, bok.BOOKSET_TYPE BOOKSET_TYPE, bok.ACCT_MODE ACCT_MODE, bok.BOK_SPEC_MODE BOK_SPEC_MODE, bok.ACCT_SUBJECT_ID ACCT_SUBJECT_ID, bok.ACCT_SUBJECT_TYPE ACCT_SUBJECT_TYPE, bok.STANDARD_CCY STANDARD_CCY, bok.BOOKSET_ID_TMPL BOOKSET_ID_TMPL, bok.ACCT_STANDARD ACCT_STANDARD, bok.START_DATE START_DATE, bok.END_DATE END_DATE, bok.CREATE_USER CREATE_USER, bok.CREATE_DEPT CREATE_DEPT, bok.CREATE_TIME CREATE_TIME, bok.UPDATE_USER UPDATE_USER, bok.UPDATE_TIME UPDATE_TIME from BOK_BOOKSET bok inner join BOK_BATCH_TASK_TODO todo on bok.bookset_id = todo.bookset_id where todo.seq_no = #{seqNo,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and todo.bookset_date = #{booksetDate,jdbcType=DATE} and todo.book_date = #{bookDate,jdbcType=DATE} and todo.happen_date = #{happenDate,jdbcType=DATE} and todo.task_id = #{taskId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and bok.bookset_type = #{booksetType,jdbcType=VARCHAR} /* 银行账 */

select NVL(fp.p_finprod_id, fp.finprod_id) as busiId,/*业务明细代码*/ fp.finprod_id as finprodId,/*金融产品代码*/ 0 as branch,/*分支序号*/ fp.profit_type as profitType,/*收益类型*/ bok.standard_ccy as ccy,/*币种*/ bok.bookset_id as bokbooksetId /*理财账套*/ from FIN_PRODUCT fp inner join BOK_BOOKSET bok on fp.finprod_id = bok.acct_subject_id and fp.finprod_type = bok.acct_subject_type left join FIN_PRODUCT_ADD fpx on fp.finprod_id = fpx.finprod_id where fp.finprod_type = #{finprodType,jdbcType=VARCHAR} /* 理财产品 */ and fpx.profit_flag = #{profitFlag,jdbcType=VARCHAR} /* 非保本浮动收益型 */
